verdict.rationale: The evidence documents skill installation via the `skills` CLI and skills that instruct agents to run `yy ledger` CLI commands. It never documents a public programmatic API (HTTP/REST/SDK) for driving YYLO Skills. Those CLI commands belong to the separate YYLO CLI/Ledger tooling, so they are an adjacent interface rather than a documented public API of this product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
